residency_notes: Model Studio's selected region determines the access point and data-storage location, while the service deployment scope determines inference execution. Documented regions include China (Beijing), Singapore, Germany (Frankfurt), Japan (Tokyo), China (Hong Kong), and the US (Virginia); deployment scopes include Global, International, China mainland, China (Hong Kong), US, EU, and Japan. The regional documentation does not make a Zero Data Retention commitment, so retention should be treated as unknown.
prompt_training_notes: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio says it will never use your data for model training. For direct API calls, it says conversation data is not saved and only desensitized call status is recorded.

verification.notes: Verified regional OpenAI-compatible text/embeddings/Batch and native DashScope media contracts. Media endpoints require dedicated native adapters.
